high_level_description: This image captures a vibrant concert scene at a large stadium. The setting is a packed arena with a crowd of enthusiastic fans, many of whom are holding up their phones or light sticks, creating a sea of blue lights that illuminates the entire venue. The atmosphere is electric and lively, with the audience actively engaged in the performance. In the foreground, two individuals are prominently featured from behind, raising their hands in the air, likely cheering or dancing along to the music. Their silhouettes stand out against the brightly lit stage and the sea of blue lights.
